fact_check_verdict: Publishable only as a story about an unadopted University of Alaska governance draft and a separate preliminary FY28 automation request. It is not a new policy, funded implementation, deployment, or measured result.

claims.spoken: The University of Alaska Board is scheduled to discuss a draft called A I Engaged.
requires: Say scheduled to discuss. Never say adopted, approved, enacted, mandated, or in effect.

claims.spoken: The draft starts with six principles.
claims.verbatim_source: The draft lists Human-Centered, Dedicated to Learning, Access, Ethical & Transparent, Secure & Protected, and Return on Innovation.
requires: Present them as proposed principles, not operating rules.

claims.verbatim_source: The draft lists Student Learning, Faculty Teaching, Administrative Efficiency, and Arctic & Climate Research.
requires: Do not imply any priority is funded or deployed.

claims.spoken: Its implementation summary adds five systemwide expectations.
claims.verbatim_source: The summary lists Institutional Policy, Secure Environments/Data & Tool Governance, Human-in-the-Loop Assurance, Universal AI Literacy, and Appropriate AI in Every Discipline.
requires: Call these proposed expectations or workstreams. Do not call them five adopted policies.

claims.spoken: If the Board adopts it, a one-year clock starts for a coordinated plan, university policies, and university plans presented to the Board.
claims.verbatim_source: The implementation summary ties the one-year timeline to approval or adoption.
requires: IF ADOPTED must remain visible. The clock has not started. Do not state a September 2027 deadline.

claims.on_screen: UAA · UAF · UAS KEEP CURRICULUM JUDGMENT
claims.spoken: U A A, U A F, and U A S would keep responsibility for curriculum, academic integrity, faculty use, and research policy.
claims.verbatim_source: The draft reserves university-specific curriculum, faculty use of AI, academic-integrity standards, and research policy to the separately accredited universities.
requires: This autonomy remains inside system principles and future system policy. Do not say campuses can ignore system rules.

claims.spoken: Faculty would decide whether course objectives require, encourage, limit, or exclude A I.
claims.verbatim_source: The summary says faculty judgment governs whether AI is required, encouraged, limited, or excluded in a course.
requires: Keep the decision tied to course objectives.

claims.spoken: Predictive A I affecting admissions, financial aid, advising, or H R analytics would need documented evaluation and meaningful human oversight.
claims.verbatim_source: The implementation summary names admissions, financial aid, advising, and HR analytics as examples of consequential AI and calls for documented evaluation and meaningful human oversight.
requires: Do not imply UA currently uses AI for these functions or that a human must make every final decision.

claims.on_screen: A CREDENTIAL STILL CERTIFIES EARNED COMPETENCE
claims.spoken: The draft says a U A credential must still certify competence the student earned.
claims.verbatim_source: A credential from UA will continue to certify competence the student has earned.
requires: This is a proposed principle, not a measured learning outcome.

claims.spoken: The draft also proposes shared tool review, contracts, training, and legal support regardless of university size or resources.
claims.verbatim_source: The draft's Shared Uplift principle describes common infrastructure, professional development, tool evaluation, vendor contracting, and legal guidance regardless of university size or resources.
requires: Describe this as proposed shared capacity. No access outcome or tool list is reported.

claims.spoken: A separate preliminary F Y twenty-eight request seeks three hundred thousand dollars for A I and enterprise automation pilots.
claims.verbatim_source: UASO Artificial Intelligence and Enterprise Automation Initiative: $300,000 unrestricted general funds, zero listed FTE, to explore, pilot, and deploy AI and process automation.
requires: Say request, separate, and preliminary. Do not say appropriated, committed, awarded, or exclusively AI spending.

claims.spoken: The packet does not earmark that money to the draft.
claims.verbatim_source: The AI Engaged presentation and the initial FY28 budget review are separate agenda items, and the packet states budget appropriation decisions are outside the AI Engaged implementation effort.
requires: If later official action links the two, update this claim before delivery.

claims.spoken: The budget request is still under initial review and is expected to be refined before the November Board meeting.
claims.verbatim_source: The proposed request is marked as submitted by MAUs and will be refined and prioritized before the November Board Meeting.
requires: Do not present the amount as a final Board request or state appropriation.

claims.spoken: The proposed principles include human-centered learning, access, ethical transparency, security, and return on innovation.
claims.verbatim_source: The six headings are Human-Centered, Dedicated to Learning, Access, Ethical & Transparent, Secure & Protected, and Return on Innovation.
requires: Keep these inside the six proposed principles.

claims.spoken: The four proposed priorities run from student learning and faculty teaching to administration and Arctic and climate research.
claims.verbatim_source: The four priorities are Student Learning, Faculty Teaching, Administrative Efficiency, and Arctic & Climate Research.
requires: Do not imply any priority is funded or operating.

claims.spoken: The proposed expectations include universal AI literacy, secure environments and tool governance, and human-in-the-loop assurance.
claims.verbatim_source: The five expectations include Secure Environments, Data & Tool Governance; Human-in-the-Loop Assurance; and Universal AI Literacy.
requires: Describe these as proposed expectations, not current protections.

claims.spoken: The implementation draft calls for a systemwide AI Coordinating Council.
claims.verbatim_source: The implementation summary calls for a systemwide AI Coordinating Council to coordinate implementation.
requires: Say would or calls for. Do not present the council as already established.
